question: The Social Endeavour for Health and Telemedicine (SEHAT) scheme was launched in December 2020 for the residents of:

options.text: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

solution:
The correct answer is __**Jammu and Kashmir**.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• PM Modi launched **Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY SEHAT** to extend coverage to all residents of **Jammu & Kashmir**.
